title.narrative: Supporting Financial Service Providers (FSPs) to use Digital Financial Services to Increase Financial Inclusion for MSMEs in Conflict-Affected Areas in Northern Ethiopia

description.narrative: Through strengthening financial institutions and working on the supply side constraints of financial service providers, the action aims to improve lost traditional capacity of the financial institutions to lend in combination with tech-based Digital Financial Services (DFS) for MSMEs.
